- User requires a real Spanish-language IVX IA developer interaction, not canned health/status responses.
- Show only genuine evidence: task/job IDs, changed files, tests, commits, deployment identifiers, and production verification.
- Never expose or commit secret values.
- Do not claim successful deployment, senior-developer certification, APK delivery, or device QA without recorded proof.
- Android APK remains a direct-install/sideload artifact, debug-signed rather than a Play Store release.

## Progress
### Done
- Production baseline verified:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health
  HTTP 200
  status healthy
  environment production
  commit 362e7f5e4699ff8c013367901909f27a33857fa5
  serviceName ivx-holdings-platform
  version ivx-owner-ai-backend-v2026.07.26
  bootTime 2026-08-02T11:23:59.380Z
  ```

- Confirmed actual senior-developer worker design in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`:
  ```text
  repo read → file create/modify → tests → typecheck → build → commit → push → Render deploy → poll deploy → verify /health + /version
  ```
  and expected stages:
  ```text
  QUEUED → RUNNING → PATCHING → TESTING → COMMITTING → DEPLOYING → VERIFYING → COMPLETED/FAILED
  ```
- Identified the execution-console auth gap in live source:
  ```tsx
  <ExecutionConsoleBubble
    initialStatus={coerced}
    authToken={null}
  />
  ```
  in `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/hooks/useExecutionStatusPoll.ts` was updated to:
  - import `getIVXAccessToken` from `@/lib/ivx-supabase-client`;
  - resolve the active owner session when no prop token is supplied;
  - report HTTP 401/403 as an explicit owner-session error;
  - make polling exhaustion terminal `blocked` / `FAILED` rather than indefinitely working.

  ```ts
  const accessToken = session?.access_token ?? null;
  ```

  ```text
  POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login
  ```

- Verify whether the `useExecutionStatusPoll.ts` source edit is fully saved and type-correct in the now-mounted root workspace.
- Re-run the Spanish smoke-module task after the GitHub integration is repaired.
- Build and verify the new Android `1.9.4` APK after source validation and deployment evidence are complete.

- Real IVX IA code execution cannot commit, push, deploy, or certify as senior developer until this live failure is fixed:
  ```text
  Commit failed: GitHub default branch ref lookup failed: 404
  ```

- Treat the failed real worker job as proof of an operational gap, not as a successful senior-developer execution.

- Use explicit terminal failure/blocked states for expired sessions and polling timeouts, preventing misleading “working” UI.
- Exclude accidental `ios-ivx-holdings/` generated-app modifications and all incidental build artifacts from IVX commits.

7. Poll `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:jobId` through `COMPLETED`, capturing files, tests, commit SHA, deployment ID, proof ledger, and health verification.
8. Run Expo validation using the correct installed dependency environment.
9. Build Android release `1.9.4`, inspect `app-release.apk`, calculate SHA-256/size/timestamp, and upload only after successful build evidence.
10. Report IVX IA as senior-developer verified only if a fresh task completes the complete real pipeline.
